name: shopping-list
description: Family meal-plan and grocery list. Cloudflare Pages front end + Worker sync.

scripts.check: npm run build -- --check && node tools/build-foods.mjs --check && npm run scan && npm test
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy web/public --project-name shopping-list-app
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy web/site --project-name musette-site
